headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: EBITDA margin edged up to 15.5% despite roughly 150 bps of non-recurring drag (50 bps severance, 100 bps AI proof- of-concept investment), implying an underlying margin near 17%, still below management’s 18–20% aspiration.
Order book of USD 98.5mn (book-to-bill 1.18x), AI-led pipeline of USD 358mn and Harmony.ai monetisation at QSR and healthcare clients support the pivot toward AI-native engineering.
However, we see execution risk as data revenue is down roughly 50% YoY, top-account ramp-downs persist, and management flagged further TMT and BFSI softness in Q3.
Absent sustained double-digit CC growth and margin recovery toward 18%, we stay on the sidelines at this moment.
